FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
PRIVATE SECRETARY GRADE-I RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION-
2026
Public Notice
6th November, 2026
Adv. No. 01/Private Secretary Grade-I/ 2026 Dated: 12th March 2026
In reference to the Private Secretary Grade-I Recruitment Examination-2026 issued vide Adv.
No. 01/Private Secretary Grade-I/ 2026 dated 12.03.2026, it is hereby informed to all the concerned
that the Private Secretary Grade-I Recruitment Examination-2026 will be conducted by Tata
Consultancy Services Ltd on terms, conditions and modalities as enshrined in the advertisement
uploaded vide notice dated 12.03.2026.
The Stage-I Examination for the Private Secretary Grade-I Recruitment Examination-2026 is
scheduled on 17th November, 2026 in the following cities at the various centers of State of Uttar
Pradesh:
Agra
Moradabad
Bareilly
Meerut
Gorakhpur
Noida
Kanpur
Prayagraj
Lucknow
Varanasi
The City Intimation Slip of the registered candidates are now available on the official
website. Candidates are required to Click on the below mentioned link for downloading their City
Intimation Slip:
https://cdn.digialm.com:443//EForms/configuredHtml/970/103300/0y8mziEd1Eo3Ftg
5pK/login.html
Further the candidates may use the following helpline number and email for their
queries (if any):
Helpdesk Number: 9986638901 Email ID:allahabadhighcourt.helpdesk@gmail.com
(N OTE: In case, any candidate who has successfully filled up application form by completing all its stages and has
successfully paid the requisite examination fee but has not received the City intimation is advised to contact at
Helpdesk for his/her grievance redressal.)
All registered candidates are advised to regularly visit only the official website of
Allahabad High Court i.e. www.allahabadhighcourt.in for further updates and necessary
information.
Also for the convenience of the candidates the detailed advertisement for Private Secretary
Grade-I Recruitment Examination-2026 as well as Public notice dated 12.03.2026 & Public Notice
dated 23.03.2026 are also available on the official website.
